build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable number of experts and MOLE dropout for mixture-of-experts molecular ML
merge_mole_model_escnmd_backbone: merge MOLE layers into a single Linear layer in eSCNMDMoeBackbone for single-dataset inference optimization
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper that routes predictions through dataset-specific expert heads using MOLE linear layers
set_mole_coefficients: set MOLE expert mixing coefficients using atomic numbers, batch indices, and CSD mixed embeddings for routing
create_dataset_specific_single_head_wrap: create a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper that shares a single head across multiple datasets with per-dataset output routing
